g.text: RETROSPECTIVE DIAGNOSTIC | Top: fraction of available votes that are correct. Bottom: exact benefit of nine versus one.
Each point uses recorded responses on one item; positive means improvement at k=9. These groups use known outcomes.
The relationship is partly mathematical: majority voting amplifies an observed pool leaning right or wrong. It is not a prospective skill test.
